lines: [panicking] Hello? HELLO?! The network is bad! Goodbye!
[smooth, confident] Good morning! Your bank account is LOCKED. Read me the six-digit code. You have thirty seconds.
[conspiratorial] And whisper it. Don't let anyone hear.
[whispering] Okay. Whispering... This... is... Detective Rocco. Fraud Unit.
[excited, cheerful] And I'm tracing the call!
[panicking] Hello? HELLO?! The network is bad!
[nervous, fake sweet] I... I just called to say... have a nice day! Bye!
[warm, to camera] Banks never ask for your code. Never. Hang up.
